[EFFECT]
Weekday has a generally rising effect on predicted bike demand from Sunday through to Friday, then dips slightly on Saturday. Sunday sees the lowest contribution (slightly suppressing demand), while Friday has the highest (modestly boosting demand). Saturday sits in between, higher than Sunday but not quite as high as Friday. The overall spread is relatively small — the difference between the weakest day (Sunday) and the strongest (Friday) translates to roughly a 11% uplift in predicted rentals.

[IMPORTANCE]
Weekday is the second-least important feature in the model, ranked 7th out of 9. Its influence on hourly demand is noticeably smaller than factors like hour of the day, temperature, or year.

[RECOMMENDATION]
Since demand is slightly higher on weekdays — especially Fridays — and slightly lower on Sundays, it may be worth ensuring bike availability is a touch more generous heading into the working week, though the effect is modest enough that it should be considered alongside stronger demand drivers like time of day and weather.
